title: Stitch the Fragments: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2601.06404v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Clustering (FC) faces a critical bottleneck in real-world scenarios, i.e., global clusters are rarely intact, often fragmenting into incomplete, multi-granular unlabeled ``clusterlets'' distributed across Non-IID clients. Although hierarchical clustering is theoretically well-suited to model such nested distributions, its recursive nature strictly relies on multi-round communication, introducing prohibitive computational overhead and severe privacy vulnerabilities. This paper, therefore, proposes a novel one-shot hierarchical federated clustering framework designed to seamlessly ``stitch'' the fragmented local clusterlets into a holistic global distribution. translated_title: 拼接碎片：一次性层次化联邦聚类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.06404v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：联邦聚类（FC）在现实场景中面临关键瓶颈，即全局聚类很少完整，常常分裂成不完整的、多粒度的未标记“簇片段”，分布在非独立同分布（Non-IID）客户端上。尽管层次聚类在理论上非常适合建模这种嵌套分布，但其递归性质严格依赖于多轮通信，引入了高昂的计算开销和严重的隐私漏洞。因此，本文提出了一种新颖的一次性层次化联邦聚类框架，旨在无缝“拼接”碎片化的局部簇片段，形成整体的全局分布。我们的方法使客户端能够自主进行细粒度分布探索，通过动态参数交错机制上传原型级知识，以打乱传输轨迹，有效防止服务器追踪个体数据。
tldr: 本文提出了一种一次性层次化联邦聚类框架，通过动态参数交错机制保护隐私，无需多轮通信即可将分散的簇片段拼接成全局分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-shot hierarchical federated clustering framework that stitches fragmented clusterlets into a global distribution without multi-round communication, using a dynamic parameter-interleaving mechanism to protect privacy.
